notes.title: Kickstarter for physical Dark Fantasy puzzles
notes.content:
Our other jigsaw puzzle series, Dark Fantasy is getting a Kickstarter campaign!
 
If we reach our Kickstarter goal, we will produce physical puzzles for one-time occasion.
If you are interested in physical Dark Fantasy puzzles and support this event:

[h2][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dark-fantasy/dark-fantasy-jigsaw-puzzles?ref=aggd73]Kickstarter Page[/url][/h2]
